svg.text: Partitioners: how the range is chopped
default; splits adaptively to feed idle workers
use when: you tuned grainsize by hand
one even chunk per worker, no stealing
use when: uniform work, low overhead
replay the same mapping across calls
use when: cache reuse over iterations
start with auto_partitioner; only switch when profiling shows imbalance or cache misses
